svg.title: Somali Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 1500 km. Northeast-monsoon southward Somali coastal branch from an OSW northern gate at 7 N to an OSW confluence gate at 3 S. Source latitude ranges are 6-8 N for divergence and 2-4 S for confluence with East African Coast Current. Excludes the northward flow north of the divergence, offshore feeder, eastward continuation, undercurrents and gyre circuits. No year-round whole-current extent asserted. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate winter southward coastal branch — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Schott & McCreary (2001); OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
